brief: Inserts items into a list before or after a position, moves an item to another place and swaps two items.
detail: Build one with new stzListInserter(aList) or over a stzList object; it keeps its own copy, so the list you passed in is not changed, and Content gives the result. Positions count from 1. Insert, InsertBeforePosition and InsertAfterPosition accept the item as a plain value and the place as a number or a named pair such as [ :After, 2 ]. Out-of-range positions are not handled the same way by every method: most ignore them without a message, InsertAt raises, and a position two or more past the end kills the process through a missing method; see the warnings.
